questions.q: Who join Paul in writing to the Thessalonians?
questions.evidence: Paul, Silvanus, and Timothy, to the assembly of the Thessalonians in God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ

questions.q: Who will rise first when the Lord descends from heaven?
questions.evidence: The dead in Christ will rise first

questions.q: How does the day of the Lord come?
options: Like a thief in the night
questions.evidence: For you yourselves know well that the day of the Lord comes like a thief in the night
